answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade at the wharf of the marketplace, with the deposit growing with volume: a newcomer starts small, and reaching the zenith of trusted trading tiers demands a larger locked stake that is slashed if peers prove fraud. One human can still create many identities, but each ember of fake activity now burns real money, so flooding the market with a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn their deposit back through good work.
